hosted_shape_measurement.notes: rows_after reflects pre-change 24h of events; with the new emission rate live data falls to about 800 rows/day. The one-time VACUUM holds the writer lock about 2.9s once (probe busy timeout is 10s, probe window 30s); it is deferred while live data exceeds 192 MiB and skipped when free disk is under 2x live bytes. Ongoing steps are chunked at 256 pages with 250ms busy timeout and skip instead of waiting.
